column1: # GCK (glucokinase / hexokinase-4) orthosteric + allosteric residue atlas.
# Numbering: GCK_HUMAN / UniProt P35557 (465 aa, pancreatic beta-cell isoform 1). All residue identities validated against the P35557 sequence.
# Sources: Liu et al. 2012 JBC 287:13598-13610 'Insights into Mechanism of Glucokinase Activation' (Fig1A glucose+ATP site, Fig1C wide-open glucose site, Fig1D allosteric GKA site);

#   Kamata et al. 2004 Structure 12:429-438 (Fig4A active/glucose site, Fig4B allosteric site, GKRP interface Glu51~Glu52 & His141~Leu144); Liao & Lehner 2026 Nat Commun (orthosteric residue-range definitions);
#   Gersing et al. & Heredia et al. (variant activity effects).

# site_class: glucose_site / ATP_site = orthosteric (substrate) pockets; allosteric_activator_site = GKA-binding pocket (small+large domain hinge, helix C); helixC_apo = Arg447-Asp205 apo salt bridge; GKRP_site = allosteric-inhibitor (GKRP) interface.

# variant: characterized amino-acid substitution(s) at this position (';'-separated). direction: activating (GoF/hypoglycemia) vs inhibitory (LoF/MODY2) mutational effect; dual = opposing effects reported; blank = structural site annotation only.
# pockets: ligand/pocket the residue lines (glucose | ATP | GKA | GKRP). evidence: paper_figure tokens. NOTE: Liu Fig1 legend prints 'Arg477' -> recorded as Arg447 (see that row).
# ALLOSTERIC additions (Liao & Lehner 2026, Fig2E): three-star (expert-reviewed) ClinVar PATHOGENIC variants residing OUTSIDE orthosteric sites
#   (black triangles in Fig2E), inferred loss-of-function via allosteric mechanisms. site_class=allosteric, region=non-orthosteric, direction=inhibitory. R191Q merged into the existing R191 row.
